notes.title: Community Requests Implemented!
notes.notes:
We've just pushed a small update that includes several features directly requested by the community. We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and we’re excited to roll out a few of the most common suggestions:

New in this update:
[list]
[*]Added a Film Grain toggle in the Main Menu
[*]You can now scroll the camera with the left/right arrow keys
[*]Pressing Z toggles between your available Officers for quicker selection
[/list]
These changes may be small, but they came straight from your feedback, and we really appreciate everyone who’s been taking the time to share suggestions.

If you see something you asked for in this update (or just appreciate the continued support), feel free to drop a review! They means a lot to us and help with the Algoritm.

notes.title: A few more little improvements for you...
notes.notes:
We're continuing to make Warfare Legacy Collection even better as your feedback rolls in. A few more changes in this version that we think you'll like.

- Fixed a bug that occasionally caused tank visuals to come back to life after the tank is destroyed.
- Made the system better at recognizing clicks (as opposed to mouse dragging) when targeting and selecting lanes.
- 1917: Fixed a problem where only the frontmost squad in a trench with multiple squads would recognize the enemy.

notes.title: Warfare Legacy Collection remasters two classics Flash strategy games and it's out now
notes.notes:
I'm certain plenty of readers will remember the Flash classics Warfare 1917 and Warfare 1944! They're back, better than ever and expanded with the Warfare Legacy Collection now available.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/05/warfare-legacy-collection-remasters-two-classics-flash-strategy-games-and-its-out-now/

notes.title: May 1, 2025 Update Notes
notes.notes:
We're blown away by how positive the feedback is to Warfare Legacy Collection. But we're continuing to listen carefully to your feedback to look for ways to make the game even better. In this version:

- Adjusted game balance, especially in the final 1917 British mission.
- Tuned the difficulty of the "Recruit" level downward. If you find it's too easy for you, try a more advanced level.
- Clicking a group of squads now cycles through which one is selected. This makes it easier to select officers when they're clustered together with other squads.

Thanks so much for enjoying Warfare Legacy Collection! We'll keep making it even better.

notes.title: WARFARE LEGACY COLLECTION - NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.notes:
Soldiers, the wait is over — [b]Warfare Legacy Collection[/b] is officially LIVE on Steam!

This fully remastered collection brings the iconic tactical warfare series back to life with upgraded visuals, modernized engine, and all the explosive strategy you remember — plus a brand new campaign that will put all your skills to the test!

[b]Introducing the Battle of the Bulge Campaign[/b]
Take command in one of the most intense conflicts of World War II. This never-before-seen campaign adds fresh missions and a snowy storm of strategic challenges.

[b]What’s Included:[/b]
Remastered versions of Warfare 1917 & Warfare 1944
All original campaigns and bonus missions
Brand new Battle of the Bulge campaign
Overhauled art, game engine and additional VO 

Whether you're a veteran of the trenches or new to the frontlines, [b]Warfare Legacy Collection[/b] is your command post for classic tactical glory.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2745870/Warfare_Legacy_Collection/

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/03/two-classic-flash-strategy-games-make-a-return-in-april-with-the-warfare-legacy-collection/

notes.title: Launching on April 28!
notes.notes:
We're excited to announce that Warfare Legacy Collection will launch next month on April 28th. Alongside the original 1917 & 1944 campaigns, this collection features something entirely new for longtime fans and first-time players: the Battle of the Bulge campaign.

Built exclusively for this release, [b]Battle of the Bulge[/b] introduces a full set of missions inspired by the brutal winter conflict of 1944. You’ll fight through snow-covered forests, seize key crossroads, defend crumbling lines, and push back against a sudden German offensive. These missions offer new tactical challenges and a fresh perspective on one of WWII’s most pivotal battles.

Check out the new trailer below to see the Battle of the Bulge:
